faq.q: What should I prepare before friendly local service?
faq.a: A clear path to the work area and a few details about the problem are usually enough; we will tell you if more is needed. Ask us about on time updates or quick replies and the answer is the same.

faq.q: Do you explain the local business work before starting?
faq.a: Always. We describe each step, the materials and the cost, and begin only when you are comfortable. The same approach applies to friendly local service and quick replies.

faq.q: Can I ask questions after easy contact?
faq.a: Yes. Message us any time after the job and we will answer or come back to check. This applies to friendly local service, clear pricing and the rest of our local business work.

faq.q: Do you handle small local business jobs too?
faq.a: Yes. Small and large jobs get the same care, and we quote both in the same clear way. It is the same for clear pricing as it is for friendly local service.

faq.q: How do you charge for honest advice?
faq.a: We quote by the job and tell you what is included, so the final bill matches what we agreed. That goes for easy contact and honest advice too.
